$comment: FLIPKART worker, on a home connection. Read by the worker started from
This file sizes the worker: its identity pool and request budget. How many
Flipkart products are scraped, and how often, are set in the dashboard
under Settings -> Flipkart, where the API and both workers can all see them.
The budget below is deliberately modest. This line is also your own
household's connection to Flipkart, so a block here is a block on you.
Raise ipCap.adaptive.maxPerMin in small steps and watch the Flipkart
scraper panel on the dashboard for blocks before raising it again.

connection.$comment: A household line. Keeps the identity pool at a plausible number of devices.

identities.$comment: 12 is the most devices a household plausibly has; the worker warns above it.

ipCap.$comment: Starts at 3 requests/min and learns upward to at most 6.

limits.$comment: Flipkart's product limit lives in Settings; capacity here is not used for Flipkart.
